# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
# 批量核验批注稿：按文档顺序解析正文（含表格、附件），
# 每个批注ID从自己的 commentRangeStart 起收集 w:t，直到同ID commentRangeEnd。
import zipfile, re

z = zipfile.ZipFile("立式冷柜采购合同.批注稿.docx")
doc = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

# tokenize document body in order
token_re = re.compile(
    r'<w:commentRangeStart w:id="(\d+)"/>|'
    r'<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="(\d+)"/>|'
    r'<w:t(?:\s[^>]*)?>(.*?)</w:t>',
    re.S)

open_ids = set()
collected = {}   # cid -> list of text pieces
for m in token_re.finditer(doc):
    s_id, e_id, t = m.group(1), m.group(2), m.group(3)
    if s_id is not None:
        open_ids.add(s_id)
        collected.setdefault(s_id, [])
    elif e_id is not None:
        open_ids.discard(e_id)
    elif t is not None and open_ids:
        for cid in open_ids:
            collected[cid].append(t)

# check markers exist and are paired
starts = re.findall(r'<w:commentRangeStart w:id="(\d+)"/>', doc)
ends = re.findall(r'<w:commentRangeEnd w:id="(\d+)"/>', doc)
print("starts:", starts)
print("ends:  ", ends)
print("paired:", sorted(starts) == sorted(ends) == sorted(set(starts) | set(ends)))

# read comments.xml for comment ids and authors
cx = z.read("word/comments.xml").decode("utf-8")
cids = re.findall(r'<w:comment w:id="(\d+)" w:author="([^"]*)"', cx)
print("comments:", cids)

print("---- actual collected text per comment id ----")
for cid in sorted(collected, key=int):
    raw = "".join(collected[cid])
    print("ID %s: %r" % (cid, raw))
